mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compress equity discount rates by signaling sustained monetary accommodation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as market participants price in lower cost of capital for corporate cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero mean).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market health that reduces consumer spending power and corporate earnings visibility, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days as market anticipates demand contraction.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero mean).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days as market prices in reduced corporate revenue growth potential.
failure_condition: The joint decline signal (HOUST↓ and RSAFS↓) fails to predict negative returns in >60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY) triggers market expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations through rising real interest rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% (YoY) (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero mean).

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO > 105.0) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days as market reacts to improving supply conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0 (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero mean).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1700 thousand units (HOUST < 1700.0) signals housing market contraction that reduces household wealth and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as market anticipates demand slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST < 1700.0 (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero mean).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM) and unemployment decline (UNRATE < 3.5%) indicate labor market tightness that fuels wage inflation and triggers monetary policy tightening expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS↑ and UNRATE↓) fails to predict negative returns in >60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: Slow GDP growth (annualized GDPC1 growth < 1.5%) signals economic deceleration that reduces corporate profit visibility and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days as market prices in recession risk.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when GDPC1 growth < 1.5% (annualized) (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero mean).
